name: Littoral Commander: Indo-Pacific
description: Professional military education wargame focused on littoral operations in the Indo-Pacific region. Designed for use in military education institutions to explore complex multi-domain operational challenges including amphibious operations, sea control, and contested maritime environments. Published by the Dietz Foundation.
reputation: used in U.S. Marine Corps and Naval professional military education institutions for Indo-Pacific operational planning instruction
notes: 3rd printing available at approximately $70 via the Dietz Foundation. Designed specifically for PME rather than recreational play. Focuses on joint and combined arms operations in island chain environments.
